title: Quarterly Bridge Playbook — OKR Initiative Resource Arbitration & Surge Coordination
creator: Asha Patel
description: Detailed playbook to align company-level OKRs with cross-functional initiatives during quarterly surges. Establishes an 'initiative bridge' — a lightweight arbitration protocol, decision router and resource allocation ladder that ties initiative-level commitments (engineering, product, design) to company OKRs, required capacity, and escalation windows. This work will create templates, cadence, and tooling recommendations for: (1) pre-quarter commitment workshop, (2) rolling surge lanes and reserve capacity buckets (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), (3) decision router for conflicting initiative demands, and (4) telemetry and dashboards in Console to show commitment vs. actuals. Pilot will surface trade-offs (latency SLOs, cost, rollout risk) and produce a reproducible onboarding checklist for future quarters.
